product_thesis: Turn repeated agent failures into evidence-backed capability changes.

last_closed_goal.title: Export an exact KAE generation manifest
last_closed_goal.summary: KAE can now publish a stable, redacted, typed identity for the source, models, prompts, policy, configuration, protocols, scenarios, and native artifacts that form one generation.

current_focus.title: Log the exact affordance set as its own event
current_focus.summary: The next slice will record exactly what the KAE planner could choose immediately before delivery, without parsing prompt labels or exposing executor mechanics.

journeys.label: I · EvoGen foundation
journeys.summary: Make the generic evolution engine deterministic, resumable, typed, and subject-neutral.

journeys.label: II · Kenshi proof
journeys.summary: Integrate a real autonomous-game subject while preserving causal and live-proof boundaries.

journeys.label: III · OpenTTD proof

journeys.label: IV · Genericity and release

proof_lanes.label: Source
proof_lanes.description: The authority exists in reviewed code or a checked-in contract.

proof_lanes.label: Static tests
proof_lanes.description: Automated tests exercise the contract without claiming an external effect.

proof_lanes.label: Portable
proof_lanes.description: A clean locked verifier reproduces the result from the repository.

proof_lanes.label: Replay
proof_lanes.description: Recorded evidence can reconstruct the relevant choice or outcome.

proof_lanes.label: Hosted CI
proof_lanes.description: The public commit passes its hosted test matrix.

proof_lanes.label: Built artifact
proof_lanes.description: An artifact was built and identified; loading is not implied.

proof_lanes.label: Installed artifact
proof_lanes.description: Installed bytes were independently identified; runtime use is not implied.

proof_lanes.label: Live effect
proof_lanes.description: Later independent engine evidence attests a world effect.

proof_lanes.label: Withheld
proof_lanes.description: The evidence does not support this claim yet.

repositories.name: EvoGen
repositories.state: G01–G08 complete; G11 planning ratchet public

capabilities.name: Deterministic evolution cycle
capabilities.plain_language: Runs an intentionally limited agent, finds a repeated missing capability, generates real plugin code, challenges it across four suites, and retains it only when the evidence clears every gate.
capabilities.not_proven: The reference diagnostician is deterministic; arbitrary model diagnosis is not proven.

capabilities.name: Persisted, resumable orchestration
capabilities.plain_language: Stores typed stage receipts and immutable artifacts so a completed stage can be resumed without silently rerunning prior work.
capabilities.not_proven: Instruction-level crash recovery inside an unfinished stage is not claimed.

capabilities.name: Subject plugin and conformance doctor
capabilities.plain_language: Discovers subjects without importing demo ontology into the generic core and checks their manifests, isolation, symmetry, and retained-generation materialization.
capabilities.not_proven: A passing doctor is additional evidence, not certification of a live environment.

capabilities.name: Frozen evaluator and candidate isolation
capabilities.plain_language: Candidate authors cannot rewrite their evaluator, scenario authority, or baseline. Rejected work remains in lineage rather than disappearing.
capabilities.not_proven: The deterministic demo does not establish model-generated candidate quality.

capabilities.name: KAE event authority and sequence
capabilities.plain_language: KAE has an audited event surface and a monotonic event sequence, closing the identity ambiguity that blocked faithful trajectory import.
capabilities.not_proven: The exact planner affordance set is not yet a dedicated event; that is G12.

capabilities.name: Exact KAE generation manifest
capabilities.plain_language: Publishes a stable, redacted identity for KAE source and runtime authorities, including independent built, staged, and installed native-artifact evidence.
capabilities.not_proven: File identity does not prove that a DLL is loaded, a process matches it, or a world effect occurred.

capabilities.name: Exact KAE affordance-set event
capabilities.plain_language: Will let replay reconstruct exactly what the planner could choose at each decision point, without prompt-label parsing.
capabilities.not_proven: Unstarted. No implementation or completion evidence is claimed.

capabilities.name: Historical and new KAE evolution cycles
capabilities.plain_language: Will convert real KAE history into hidden-answer diagnostics, then close a genuinely new deficit through supervised live proof.
capabilities.not_proven: Planned in G15–G29; no retained KAE capability is claimed yet.

capabilities.name: OpenTTD subject environment
capabilities.plain_language: Will provide a pinned, deterministic, headless second environment with causal command lifecycles and a narrow road-freight surface.
capabilities.not_proven: The local OpenTTD installation is an input, not proof of the planned environment. Repository work begins at G30.

capabilities.name: Two-subject genericity
capabilities.plain_language: Will prove that one CLI and artifact layout operate both KAE and OpenTTD without leaking either subject's ontology into EvoGen core.
capabilities.not_proven: Cross-subject generality remains withheld until G46–G49.

demo_result.label: Deterministic microworld retention proof
demo_result.scope: Portable and hosted evidence; not a live-game claim.

commands.label: Inspect the bundled subject
commands.command: uv run evogen subject doctor microworld

withheld_claims: No general model has yet been shown to infer arbitrary missing capabilities from arbitrary environments.
The KAE generation manifest does not prove that native bytes are loaded, identify a running process, or prove a world effect.
KAE is not yet registered as a complete EvoGen subject, and its production trajectory exporter is not complete.
No OpenTTD subject repository or retained OpenTTD capability exists yet.
Two-subject genericity and the first serious release remain unproven.
